Used in: `quick_verify.render_summary`

- Ubuntu: `sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y python3`

pipeline:
  name: "quick_verify"
  tracks:
    - id: "quick_verify"
      name: "Fact-checking workflow"
      cwd: ".tagma/quick_verify"
      tasks:
        - id: "gather_evidence"
          timeout: "45s"
          name: "Gather credible sources via headless OpenCode websearch"
          command: "set -e\ncli_db_dir=$(mktemp -d) || exit 1\ntrap 'rm -rf \"$cli_db_dir\"' EXIT\nmkdir -p artifacts\nclaim={{inputs.input_claim | shellquote}}\nprompt=$(printf 'Using your websearch tool, research the following claim and gather credible sources. Write artifacts/evidence.json as a JSON object with keys: claim (the exact claim text) and sources (an array of objects, each with url, title, snippet). Claim: %s' \"$claim\")\nOPENCODE_DB=\"$cli_db_dir/opencode.db\" OPENCODE_ENABLE_EXA=true \"$TAGMA_OPENCODE_CLI\" run --model deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro --permission websearch:allow \"$prompt\""
          completion:
            type: "json_schema"
            path: "artifacts/evidence.json"
            schema_path: "schema/evidence.schema.json"
          inputs:
            input_claim:
              type: string
              default: "The Eiffel Tower can be 15 cm taller during summer"
        - id: "adjudicate"
          timeout: "45s"
          name: "Adjudicate the claim against evidence"
          command: "set -e\ncli_db_dir=$(mktemp -d) || exit 1\ntrap 'rm -rf \"$cli_db_dir\"' EXIT\nOPENCODE_DB=\"$cli_db_dir/opencode.db\" \"$TAGMA_OPENCODE_CLI\" run --model deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro \"Read artifacts/evidence.json which contains the claim and gathered sources. Adjudicate whether the claim is true, false, or unverified. Write artifacts/verdict.json as a JSON object with keys: verdict (string), confidence (number 0.0 to 1.0), explanation (string), cited_sources (array of objects each with url and title).\""
          depends_on:
            - "gather_evidence"
          completion:
            type: "json_schema"
            path: "artifacts/verdict.json"
            schema_path: "schema/verdict.schema.json"
        - id: "render_summary"
          timeout: "45s"
          name: "Render VERDICT.md from the verdict"
          command: "python3 - <<'PY'\nimport json, sys\ntry:\n    with open(\"artifacts/verdict.json\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n        v = json.load(f)\nexcept Exception as e:\n    sys.stderr.write(\"failed to read verdict.json: %s\\n\" % e)\n    sys.exit(1)\nverdict = str(v.get(\"verdict\", \"\"))\nexplanation = str(v.get(\"explanation\", \"\"))\nconfidence = v.get(\"confidence\")\nconf_text = \"N/A\"\nif isinstance(confidence, (int, float)):\n    conf_text = \"%.0f%%\" % (confidence * 100)\nelif isinstance(confidence, str):\n    conf_text = confidence\nsrcs = v.get(\"cited_sources\", []) or []\nlines = [\"# Fact-Check Verdict\", \"\", \"**Verdict:** \" + verdict, \"**Confidence:** \" + conf_text, \"\", \"## Explanation\", \"\", explanation, \"\", \"## Sources\", \"\"]\nif srcs:\n    for s in srcs:\n        url = str(s.get(\"url\", \"\"))\n        title = str(s.get(\"title\", url or \"source\"))\n        lines.append(\"- [%s](%s)\" % (title, url))\nelse:\n    lines.append(\"- (no sources cited)\")\nwith open(\"artifacts/VERDICT.md\", \"w\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n    f.write(\"\\n\".join(lines) + \"\\n\")\nPY"
          depends_on:
            - "adjudicate"
          completion:
            type: "file_exists"
            path: "artifacts/VERDICT.md"
